predecessors.name: Warring States Japan
predecessors.text: Kaga Province, 'the south and western portion of Ishikawa Prefecture', whose governor the Kaga Rebellion overthrew

successors.name: Warring States Japan
successors.text: Kaga Province, 'conquered by Oda Nobunaga's general Shibata Katsuie'

capitals.name: Kanazawa area (map anchor; the ikki's own seat is not named on the pages opened)

ledger.x: 1488: the Kaga Rebellion makes the Kaga ikki master of Kaga.
1580: Oda power ends the Kaga ikki.

wars.name: Kaga Rebellion
wars.outcome: The ikki overthrew the governor and took the province; Kaga stayed self-ruled for nearly 100 years.

wars.name: Ishiyama Hongan-ji War
wars.outcome: Oda took Ishiyama Hongan-ji 'in 1580 after an 11-year siege'; the Kaga Province page has Kaga conquered by Shibata Katsuie, undated.

certainty.note: A province held by a confederation of commoners and Hongan-ji followers, with no treaty or survey line; its edge is the old provincial border, approximated here.
